name: Vengeful Cry
description: Retaliate against a savage hit with a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user. The user and nearby allies gain a buff which grants rage and prevents rage from being lost. Minions cannot gain rage.

stats: Cannot be used by default
Becomes Usable once for 2 seconds when you take a Savage Hit
Buff grants 3 Rage per second per 5 Power, counting a maximum of 25 power
Buff grants +25 to Maximum Rage
Buff prevents inherent loss of Rage
Counts total Power of Enemies in Range
Base duration is 2.50 seconds
